reference: Fixed framework OutputStyle::getOutput / Symfony Console7.4.0 ProgressBar, SymfonyStyle::askQuestion, QuestionHelper and ConsoleSectionOutput
native_adaptations: Constructors take &mut impl AsOutput rather than consuming a generic value, preserving existing mutable-reference reuse. No default heap allocation, global selection state or unsafe pointer is added.

get_output now returns &mut OutputReference rather than an unconditionally raw &mut Output. Legacy capture-buffer reads remain available; mutable raw escape is rejected by a real compile-fail consumer. Explicit raw-output helper parameter annotations can accept &mut impl AsOutput.

Standard terminal echo bypasses logical section writes, while successful interactive input adds the submission line. Prompt preparation occurs once per question, preserving validation retry behavior and partial-state errors.
Fixed ProgressBar exposes no getOutput. Source fixtures capture $out directly; the existing native ProgressOutput helper expresses exclusive sequential borrowing.

Nested styles borrow existing parent states exclusively. Vec is empty and allocation-free for ordinary root/section outputs; nesting stores references, not copied output, global target state or unsafe pointers. Optional NewLineView exposes only actual wrapped style counters; get_output reborrows the next underlying target. Parent concurrent mutation is rejected at compile time.
